title: Quick Mexican Vermicelli Noodles
description: A salty and crispy Mexican dish featuring vermicelli pasta, perfect for a quick fix, and served on a bamboo tray. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is made with a mirepoix base and is ready in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: vermicelli pasta
ingredients.notes: brown rice vermicelli for macrobiotic option

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vermicelli pasta to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the noodles to a bamboo tray and serve hot.
Garnish with additional lime juice and chili powder if desired.
Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
